cards.question: Do you know what I love most about this photo?
cards.note: The way you open your arms to the world — like it's yours. Because it is. You on your family trip, living freely, being completely yourself.
cards.hidden: Her US family trip — arms wide open, heart even wider.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl with arms wide open on a sunny city sidewalk, radiating pure joy

cards.question: Can you feel the breeze just looking at this?
cards.note: Palm trees, good vibes, and your hair doing its thing. You always know how to find the most beautiful spots — and make them even more beautiful just by being there.
cards.hidden: Somewhere warm in the US — wind, palms, and her.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl standing in a tropical field surrounded by palm trees with wind in her hair

cards.question: Honestly — how are you this photogenic?
cards.note: The lake, the mountains, the trees — but honestly, they're just your backdrop. You are really a supermodel. This is one of the best clicks of you. Out of this world.
cards.hidden: A lakeside moment that could be a movie poster.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl by a mountain lake surrounded by tall trees, wind blowing through her hair

cards.question: Do you remember how excited you were that day?
cards.note: In front of the White House, scarf on, owning the moment. You really enjoyed that day and I'm so happy you got to experience such a place. You cherish all the memories — and so do I.
cards.hidden: Washington D.C. — the White House, autumn vibes, and her biggest smile.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl on a crosswalk near the White House wearing a plaid scarf in autumn

cards.question: Selfie queen — even mid-run. How do you do it?
cards.note: You and your greenery runs. This is so you — active, free, cap on, earbuds in, sneaking selfies while the world blurs behind you.
cards.hidden: Birmingham trails — where the selfie queen does her thing.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl taking a selfie on a tree-lined nature trail wearing a cap and hoodie

cards.question: Do you remember how it felt crossing that line?
cards.note: The London Marathon. One of the biggest days of your life. Ponytail flying, heart pounding, thousands of people around you — and you did it. I am so, so proud of you.
cards.hidden: London Marathon — she ran it. She finished it. She was incredible.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl running in the London Marathon, ponytail flying, surrounded by runners

cards.question: How does it feel to look back at this moment?
cards.note: You graduated with your Master's degree. You worked so hard for this — late nights, early mornings, everything. You were shining so bright that day. I'm so proud of you, Rhea.
cards.hidden: Graduation day — a Master's degree, earned and completely deserved.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in graduation gown holding flowers on university steps

cards.question: Do you remember how hard you worked to get here?
cards.note: You pushed yourself to earn a chance to present your research in California — and you actually did it. Your hard work paid off. I was so emotionally proud of you. I still am.
cards.hidden: California — presenting her PCOS research to the world. Brilliant.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl presenting a research poster at an academic conference

cards.question: The world doesn't see this side, do they?
cards.note: Your stylish doctor era. Working hard, giving everything you have — but always managing to sneak in some cute moments even after the longest shifts. This is the real you.
cards.hidden: Behind the scenes — the work nobody sees, but everyone benefits from.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a young doctor resting in hospital scrubs in a locker room

cards.question: How are you this adorable in hospital scrubs?
cards.note: One of the cutest hospital selfies of you. Glasses on, lanyard swinging, that little pose — you make scrubs look like they belong on a runway.
cards.hidden: Doctor mode: ON. Cuteness: also very much ON.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a young doctor taking a cheerful selfie in scrubs with glasses and lanyard

cards.question: Do you know what makes you different from everyone else in a room?
cards.note: You always look so pretty in desi attire. This was a family function back home — and you walked in like you owned the place. Because you kind of did.
cards.hidden: Birmingham — family function, and she stole the whole show.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in a green floral lehenga smiling in a sunlit living room

cards.question: Lord Ganesha blessing you in the background — do you see it?
cards.note: You look so gorgeous here. Diwali celebrations, the warm golden light, and Ganesha watching over you. This photo has so much peace and beauty in it.
cards.hidden: Diwali night — blessings, light, and her.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in traditional dress holding a glowing diya with a Ganesha painting in the background

cards.question: Do you know what your smile does to me?
cards.note: You look so innocent here. Dressed for Pooja, that gentle expression — your smile brings so much calmness to my life. I really mean that.
cards.hidden: Pooja day — the smile that makes the world quieter.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in a lilac salwar with pink dupatta and bindi, gentle portrait

cards.question: The bindi, the glow — do you see how bright you shine?
cards.note: You look so amazing with that small bindi on your forehead. Getting ready for Pooja, golden and glowing — you shine so bright every single time.
cards.hidden: Getting ready — bindi on, shine on, always.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in golden kurta with embroidered dupatta smiling warmly

cards.question: Do you remember where we went for your birthday dinner?
cards.note: The sun was shining on you, that purple dress, the garden around you. We were heading to Mayfair for your birthday dinner. You looked absolutely breathtaking that evening.
cards.hidden: Isabella Restaurant, Mayfair — her birthday dinner. Unforgettable.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in an elegant purple satin dress in a London garden with flowers

cards.question: Do you remember this quiet evening walk?
cards.note: This photo is so stunning. You are literally a supermodel, Rhea. The quiet street, the warm lights, you walking through it all — amazing at whatever you do.
cards.hidden: A quiet Cambridge evening — and she made it cinematic.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl walking alone on a path at night with warm house lights glowing

cards.question: Do you remember where we were going that night?
cards.note: This is one of my favourite photos of you — and you know that. The city lights behind you, that black dress, that look. This is us, heading out together.
cards.hidden: Masala Zone — and yes, this is still my favourite photo of you.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl in a black dress by a window with night city lights behind her

cards.question: Do you know what your smile does for me on the hard days?
cards.note: Another date, another evening with you. Your smile really brings me comfort — more than you probably know.
cards.hidden: London date night — her smile, my favourite thing in the world.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl smiling by a window at night with city skyline, wearing a red top

cards.question: Do you remember this day?
cards.note: You lost your Nana. It was one of the hardest days. And I'm glad — truly, deeply glad — that I was there for you. Some moments matter more than others. This was one of them.
cards.hidden: The day she needed someone. And he was there.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl at home in a cozy fur jacket and beanie, posters on the wall behind her

cards.question: Think carefully... do you remember what happened this day?
cards.note: This is the day I asked you to be my girlfriend. You were travelling to the US the very next day. Let's see how much you remember about this moment.
cards.hidden: The day he proposed — and she said yes. The day before she flew to the US.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl laughing excitedly while wearing a VR headset on a couch

cards.question: You've always loved flowers. Do you remember this day?
cards.note: Valentine's Day. You always loved flowers — and you looked so amazing that day. Some things are just worth remembering, always.
cards.hidden: Valentine's Day — flowers for the one who deserves every single petal.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of someone holding a large bouquet of red flowers on Valentine's Day

cards.question: Do you remember how you felt when you walked in?
cards.note: I prepped this surprise for you. Balloons, roses, everything. And when you saw it — when your face lit up — that was one of the best days of my life.
cards.hidden: The birthday surprise — her happiness was his whole world that day.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl on a bed surrounded by birthday balloons and rose petals looking at a photo collage

cards.question: What did you wish for?
cards.note: You really liked the surprise. This is you — cutting the cake, being celebrated, being loved. Exactly the way you deserve. Happy birthday, Rhea.
cards.hidden: Cake, candles, and the girl who deserves every wish she makes.
cards.alt: Animated illustration of a girl smiling in front of a red birthday cake with lit candles, city view behind
